summary: Golden Entertainment filed an 8-K disclosing that regulatory approvals for its going-private transaction under the Master Transaction Agreement with Argento, LLC and VICI Properties have been obtained, with closing expected on or about April 30, 2026. At closing, a $2.75/share cash dividend will be paid to shareholders prior to the merger, and each share of New HoldCo common stock will be converted into 0.902 shares of PropCo Buyer Shares (stock consideration). The transaction is structured as a multi-step going-private with an OpCo sale preceding the merger. Watch for closing conditions and post-closing share valuation.
